overview: EasyBuy is a cross-platform (iOS/Android/web) e-commerce mobile app built with Expo + React Native. It offers a customer storefront (browse catalog, search, cart, wishlist, checkout, order tracking) and an admin console (dashboard, product/category CRUD, order management, user management). Client state is held in Redux (cart) and React state; the authenticated user + JWT live behind a session module backed by expo-secure-store (native) / AsyncStorage (web). All backend access goes through a single API seam (api/client.js + api/index.js) that talks to a Node backend or the bundled Express mock-server over a flat REST contract.

domain_models.name: User
domain_models.definition: An authenticated account identified by _id/email with a name, password, a role discriminator (userType: USER | ADMIN), and an auth token. Serves as both storefront customer and, when userType is ADMIN, the admin operator.

domain_models.name: Customer
domain_models.definition: A User with userType USER: the shopper persona who browses the catalog, maintains a cart and wishlist, and places orders.

domain_models.name: Admin
domain_models.definition: A User with userType ADMIN: the operator persona who manages products, categories, orders, and users through the admin dashboard; enforced by session.isAdmin() and the mock-server adminMiddleware.

domain_models.name: Product
domain_models.definition: A sellable catalog item with _id, title, sku, price, stock quantity, description, image, and an embedded category { _id, title }. Listed via GET /products and mutated by admins.

domain_models.name: Category
domain_models.definition: A grouping of products (e.g. Garments, Electronics, Cosmetics, Groceries) with _id, title, description, and icon/image. Managed via /categories endpoints.

domain_models.name: Cart
domain_models.definition: The client-side (Redux) list of products the customer intends to buy. Not persisted server-side; reduced by the cartReducer under the 'product' slice.

domain_models.name: CartItem
domain_models.definition: A line within the Cart: a Product snapshot plus a chosen quantity and an avaiableQuantity (in-stock cap). Add/remove and increase/decrease-quantity actions mutate it.

domain_models.name: Wishlist
domain_models.definition: A customer's saved-for-later collection of products (productId + quantity), managed via /wishlist, /add-to-wishlist, and /remove-from-wishlist.

domain_models.name: Order
domain_models.definition: A placed purchase with orderId, buyer reference, line items, amount, discount, payment_type (cod), shipping fields (country/city/zipcode/shippingAddress), and a status lifecycle: pending -> shipped -> delivered, plus createdAt/updatedAt/shippedOn/deliveredOn.

domain_models.name: OrderItem
domain_models.definition: A line within an Order: a productId reference { _id, title } with the price and quantity captured at checkout time.

domain_models.name: Session
domain_models.definition: The authenticated identity lifecycle: the logged-in user object plus JWT-style token stored under 'authUser' in SecureStore (native) / AsyncStorage (web). The token is sent as the x-auth-token header; a 'jwt expired' response clears the session and resets navigation to login.

domain_models.name: Dashboard
domain_models.definition: Admin aggregate view exposing counts of users, orders, products, and categories via GET /dashboard.

applications.name: easybuy-mobile
applications.backend_seam: api/client.js (transport) + api/index.js (named REST operations); base URL resolved by api/config.js from EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL

applications.name: easybuy-mock-server
applications.description: Local development-only Express server (port 3002) with in-memory seed data that replicates the flat REST contract the mobile app consumes (auth, products, categories, orders, wishlist, admin, uploads). Not shipped with the app.
